description: Land Acquisition - Elagamuwa, Naula D/S/D, Matale District
categorisation: The gazette content is a formal notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of specific land parcels for the Moragahakanda/Kaluganga Development Project. It provides detailed descriptions of the land (lot numbers, names, extent, current use, claimants) and procedures for interested parties to claim compensation. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, which includes land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative matters. The content does not involve government personnel/structure changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized category (5-9) as its primary subject is land.
